services.name: Museum Rentals
services.desc: Join the Trailhead for a special story time, every Thursday at 11am! Each week we will welcome a special guest reader from the community. Included with museum admission. As a part of our Worldwide Day of Play celebration, join the Trailhead for a FREE screening of “Playing For Keeps” at our local community movie theatre, the Majestic. Consider the official definition of play: engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose. And yet hard science and deep wisdom tell us that play is neither silly nor impractical. The desire to engage in enjoyable experiences for their own sake is hard-wired into the brains of all mammals, and humans are no exception.

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: The museum welcomes field trips for local children’s organizations, schools, and childcare centers. Play-based field trips are $5 per child for 2 hours of playtime and include up to 20 kids. Groups must provide a minimum of 1 adult per 10 children for supervision. An Art Bar or Maker Station-specific field trip is available for an additional cost determined by activity and supplies. Please note, availability is dependent on museum operations and is extremely limited in the summer
